BiblicalUsage: Chisloth-tabor is a place in Palestine, named once as a border mark. Joshua 19:12 draws the border of Issachar from Sarid eastward to the border of Chisloth-tabor, then out to Daberath.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe border towns belong in the record too: the inheritance was measured out town by town, and God gave His people land with edges they could walk.
